name: Eggs, in shell
tips: Keep in the carton on a fridge shelf, not the door. Do not freeze in the shell.

name: Eggs, hard-boiled
tips: Refrigerate within 2 hours of cooking.

name: Milk, toned (pouch)
keywords: milk|toned milk|double toned milk|doodh|cow milk|buffalo milk|milk pouch
tips: Boil or use within a day of opening. Thaw frozen milk in the fridge.

name: Milk, full cream
tips: Keep boiled milk covered in the fridge.

name: Milk, UHT carton (unopened)
keywords: uht milk|tetra pack milk|long life milk|carton milk
tips: Pantry while sealed. Once opened refrigerate and use within 3-5 days.

name: Curd / dahi (homemade)
tips: Sours quickly at room temperature; keep covered in the fridge.

name: Yogurt, packaged (cup)
tips: Use within 3 days of opening.

name: Paneer, fresh (loose)
tips: Store submerged in water in a closed box; change the water daily.

name: Paneer, packaged (opened)
tips: Unopened packs: follow the printed date.

name: Butter
tips: Keep wrapped; butter absorbs fridge smells.

name: Ghee
tips: Use a dry spoon; moisture makes ghee go rancid.

name: Cheese, processed (slices, cubes, spread)
keywords: cheese|cheese slice|cheese slices|cheese cubes|cheese spread|processed cheese
tips: Unopened: follow the printed date.

name: Cheese, hard (cheddar, parmesan)
tips: Cut away 2-3 cm around any mould spot.

name: Fresh cream / malai
tips: Frozen cream separates; use it for cooking.

name: Condensed milk, opened
tips: Unopened tins keep in the pantry until the printed date.

name: Milk powder (opened)
tips: Keep tightly closed and dry.

name: Ice cream
tips: Keep at the back of the freezer; refreezing melted ice cream is unsafe.

name: Bread, sliced (white, brown, multigrain)
keywords: bread|white bread|brown bread|double roti|sandwich bread|multigrain bread|loaf
tips: Fridge slows mould but dries bread; freeze slices for toast.

name: Rusk / toast
tips: Keep in an airtight jar once opened.

name: Roti / chapati, cooked
tips: Freeze with butter paper between rotis.

name: Biscuits and cookies, opened
tips: Keep in an airtight jar; soft biscuits have gone stale.

name: Namkeen and bhujia, opened
tips: Oil-rich snacks go rancid in heat; keep sealed.

name: Spinach / palak
tips: Wrap unwashed leaves in a dry cloth, then a bag. Blanch before freezing.

name: Coriander leaves / dhania
tips: Stand stems in water or wrap in a damp paper towel in a box.

name: Fenugreek leaves / methi
tips: Dry thoroughly before storing; kasuri methi keeps for months.

name: Curry leaves / kadi patta
tips: Strip from stems and store dry in a box.

name: Tomatoes
tips: Ripen on the counter; refrigerate only once fully ripe.

name: Onions
tips: Whole onions in a dry airy basket away from potatoes. Fridge days are for cut onion.

name: Potatoes
tips: Cool dark place; do not refrigerate raw potatoes. Discard green or sprouted parts.

name: Ginger / adrak
tips: Fridge in a paper bag; freeze peeled and grate from frozen.

name: Garlic / lahsun
tips: Whole bulbs in a dry airy place. Fridge days are for peeled cloves.

name: Ginger-garlic paste (homemade)
keywords: ginger garlic paste|adrak lahsun paste|gg paste
tips: Freeze in ice-cube trays. Never store garlic in oil at room temperature.

name: Green chillies / hari mirch
tips: Remove stems and store dry in a box.

name: Carrots / gajar
tips: Cut off leafy tops before storing. Blanch before freezing.

name: Okra / bhindi
tips: Store dry and unwashed; moisture makes it slimy.

name: Green peas, fresh (in pod) / matar
tips: Shell and blanch before freezing.

name: Green peas, frozen
tips: Cook from frozen; do not refreeze thawed peas.

name: Mushrooms
tips: Keep in a paper bag; plastic makes them slimy.

name: Pumpkin / kaddu
tips: Whole pumpkin in the pantry. Fridge days are for cut pieces wrapped in film.

name: Bananas / kela
tips: Freeze peeled ripe bananas for shakes.

name: Apples / seb
tips: Keep away from other fruit; apples speed up ripening.

name: Mango, ripe / aam
tips: Freeze as pulp or cubes.

name: Grapes / angoor
tips: Wash just before eating.

name: Pomegranate / anar
tips: Separated seeds keep 3-5 days in the fridge.

name: Watermelon / tarbooz
tips: Fridge days are for cut melon in a covered box.

name: Pineapple / ananas
tips: Fridge days are for cut pineapple.

name: Coconut, whole
tips: Tender coconut water: drink the same day.

name: Strawberries
tips: Remove mouldy berries straight away.

name: Rice, uncooked (white, basmati)
tips: Airtight container; add a few dried neem leaves or bay leaves against weevils.

name: Rice, cooked
tips: Cool and refrigerate within 1 hour; reheat until steaming hot.

name: Atta / whole wheat flour
keywords: atta|wheat flour|whole wheat flour|gehun ka atta|chakki atta|godhuma pindi
tips: Whole-grain flours turn rancid in heat; refrigerate in summer.

name: Suji / rava / semolina
tips: Dry-roast before storing to keep insects away.

name: Toor dal / arhar
keywords: toor dal|tur dal|arhar dal|tuvar dal|pigeon pea|dal|daal|togari bele

name: Rajma / kidney beans, dry
tips: Soak and boil hard for 10 minutes; undercooked rajma is toxic.

name: Sprouts (moong / chana)
tips: Rinse well; children and pregnant people should eat sprouts cooked.

name: Sugar / cheeni
tips: Keep dry; sugar does not spoil but attracts ants.

name: Jaggery / gur
tips: Airtight jar; refrigerate in the monsoon.

name: Cooking oil, opened (sunflower, mustard, groundnut)
keywords: oil|cooking oil|sunflower oil|mustard oil|sarson ka tel|groundnut oil|refined oil|tel|rice bran oil
tips: Store away from the stove; discard if it smells sharp or paint-like.

name: Honey / shahad
tips: Crystallised honey is fine; warm the jar in water.

name: Pickle / achar, opened
tips: Always use a dry spoon; discard if mould appears.

name: Sauces, opened (soy, chilli, schezwan)
keywords: soy sauce|chilli sauce|schezwan sauce|green chilli sauce|hot sauce|vinegar

name: Tamarind / imli
tips: Tamarind paste: fridge 30-60 days after opening.

name: Turmeric powder / haldi
tips: Ground spices lose flavour before they spoil; buy small packs.

name: Red chilli powder / lal mirch
keywords: red chilli powder|lal mirch|mirchi powder|kashmiri mirch|chilli powder

name: Garam masala and spice blends
keywords: garam masala|masala|chole masala|sambar powder|pav bhaji masala|chaat masala|kitchen king

name: Whole spices (cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaf, pepper)
Asafoetida / hing
tips: Keep the tin tightly shut; its smell spreads.

name: Peanuts / moongphali, raw
tips: Discard peanuts that taste bitter or look mouldy.

name: Chicken, raw
keywords: chicken|murgi|murga|chicken breast|chicken curry cut|boneless chicken|drumsticks chicken
tips: Keep on the bottom shelf in a sealed box; thaw in the fridge.

name: Fish, fresh
tips: Gut and clean before storing; keep on ice in a box.

name: Chicken or meat curry, cooked
keywords: chicken curry|mutton curry|butter chicken|biryani|leftover chicken|cooked meat
tips: Reheat until steaming hot all the way through.

name: Cooked sabzi and curries (veg)
tips: Refrigerate within 2 hours of cooking.

name: Tofu, opened
tips: Store submerged in water; change daily.

name: Idli / dosa batter
tips: Very sour or pink-tinged batter should be discarded.
